submit_request.modern:
def submit_request(data):
        request = lock_request(data.get('name'), data)
        editable(request, actor())
        old = document_values(request)
        normalize(request)
        request.revision = int(request.revision or 0) + 1
        request.status = 'Pending Workflow Selection'
        request.submitted_at = frappe.utils.now()
        request.supplier = None
        request.current_instance = None
        request.priced_at = None
        request.priced_by = None
        for field in ['final_subtotal', 'final_tax', 'final_total']:
            request.set(field, 0)
        for line in request.items:
            for field in ['final_unit_price_net', 'final_unit_price_gross', 'vat_percent', 'final_subtotal', 'final_tax', 'final_amount']:
                line.set(field, 0)
        persist(request)
        frappe.call('purchase_approval.workflow_runtime.bridge', action='start_submitted', request=request)
        audit(request, 'Submit', old=old)
        return request_details(request)

read_capabilities.modern:
def read_capabilities(user):
        dynamic = frappe.call('purchase_approval.workflow_runtime.bridge', action='capabilities', user=user)
        return {
            'create': has_role(user, 'PA Requester'),
            'stock_check': dynamic['stock_check'] or has_role(user, 'PA Stock Checker'),
            'selection': dynamic['selection'],
            'approvals': dynamic['approvals'] or any(has_role(user, role) for role in ['PA Approver', 'PA Manager', 'PA Company Admin']),
            'purchasing': dynamic['purchasing'] or has_role(user, 'PA Purchasing'),
            'receiving': dynamic['receiving'] or has_role(user, 'PA Receiver'),
            'administration': has_role(user, 'PA Company Admin'),
        }
